_comment: Maps an instructor name as it appears in the course schedule to the exact instructor_name in the RMP database, for cases the automatic name matching cannot join (it already ignores case, accents, punctuation and parenthetical parts like 'Jeffrey (J. P.) Zinn'). Example: {"schedule_to_rmp": {"Bob Smith": "Robert Smith"}}. The cache builder prints a warning for any schedule instructor it cannot match and that is not in the RMP 'unmatched' list.
